items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: He called me Daddy Long Legs.

ctx.x: So, somehow or other, the furniture store closed and moved out. So I told the dago boss that I know where to get him...to have a fabulous nightclub at, so he was lookin' around, say, he wanted a bigger place, so I say, I told him, I say, "I know where you get a bigger place at. Make a beautiful nightclub." There wasn't but about five or six blocks down the street but the dago ain't paid no attention to it.
Say, "Where..." He called me Daddy Long Legs. Say, "Where's it, Daddy Long Legs?"
